system.description: The Dragon-Blood extends her own Essence to sustain her mount beyond mortal endurance. While this Charm is active, the Exalt's mount does not tire, does not feel pain from non-lethal injuries, and ignores wound penalties from bashing damage. Any poison or disease affecting the mount immediately halts its progress (though it does not purge it). The mount also gains a soak bonus equal to the Exalt's Ride rating against all sources of harm. If the mount would be reduced to Incapacitated, it instead collapses when the Charm expires; the Exalt feels a jolt through the bond and may reflexively end the Charm to prevent the collapse for one additional tick.
